description: A crossfader across four inputs: one knob runs from the first to the fourth, mixing each neighbouring pair as it passes between them

params.text: Sets which input is heard, from 1 at one end to 4 at the other; between two numbers the two inputs either side are mixed in proportion

inputs.text: Adds to the position, 10V covering the whole run from the first input to the fourth
One of the four signals to be faded between; it is heard alone when the position is on its own number

outputs.text: The chosen input, or the mix of the two the position lies between

notes: the crossfade is a straight line, not equal power, so a pair of unrelated signals dips slightly in level halfway between them.
